title: Product Manager, Logistics Data Platform
posting_text:
Tessellate sells a data platform for supply-chain analytics teams.

What you'll do
- Own ingestion connectors and the semantic layer
- Work with data engineers at customer companies

What we're looking for
- 5+ years of product management on data platform or data warehouse products
- Hands-on SQL and dbt experience

Nice to have
- Supply-chain domain knowledge
